solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: In direct opposition, before guillotine's brought into action?

definitions.meaning: meeting face to face, as in a collision of two cars
the condemned person's head is still attached until the blade falls

explanation.surface: A duel described as facing straight on, followed by a grim joke about an execution.
explanation.definitionFit: A head-on clash is one where the parties meet front to front, in direct opposition.

clue.text: Dance band instruments

parts.note: a horn is a brass instrument played in a band
a pipe is a wind instrument played in a band

explanation.surface: A group of musicians plays for a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The hornpipe is a lively solo dance associated with sailors, an example of a dance.

clue.text: One element that may be split into many

indicators.note: may be split suggests the letters of into many are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Chemistry: a substance that can be divided into numerous parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Antimony is a metalloid chemical element, symbol Sb, an example of an element.

clue.text: Don't lie under it

parts.note: a witness sworn in court must tell the truth while bound by this solemn promise

explanation.surface: Advice not to rest beneath something.
explanation.definitionFit: Being under oath means sworn to tell the truth, so one must not lie under it.

clue.text: Phoney admission of poverty takes in good man

indicators.note: takes in means the confession of poverty wraps round the saint

parts.note: someone admitting poverty says I'M POOR
ST, short for saint, is the crossword good man

explanation.surface: A con man pleads poverty while sheltering a virtuous fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A phoney is a fake person, a pretender: noun synonym for a fraud.

clue.text: He'll fulfil his promise

parts.note: a person who always keeps what he has vowed to do

explanation.surface: A reliable man will keep his pledge.
explanation.definitionFit: A reliable person who keeps his promises is described by this idiom.

clue.text: Forget to put it on the order

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone forgets to put an item on the order form.
explanation.definitionFit: To omit is to leave out, which is what one does in forgetting something.

clue.text: Signs liable to be kicked over

definitions.meaning: marks or vestiges left behind
the straps of a harness, which an unruly horse kicks over, giving the idiom for rebelling

explanation.surface: Some signs that might be knocked down.
explanation.definitionFit: Traces are signs or remnants, and also the harness straps in the idiom kick over the traces.

clue.text: Joint may be worn out

definitions.meaning: a cannabis cigarette
a ... jacket, a thick double-breasted coat worn outdoors

explanation.surface: A joint in the body that may become worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: A reefer is slang for a cannabis joint and also a heavy jacket worn outdoors.

clue.text: Go round with a list at half-term

parts.note: a rota is a list of duties

indicators.note: half of the word term means its first two letters only

explanation.surface: A teacher spins round with a duty roster at the half-term break.
explanation.definitionFit: To rotate is to turn or spin about an axis, a verb synonym.

clue.text: I acted in variety show

indicators.note: variety suggests the letters of I acted in are mixed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A performer boasts of having appeared in a variety show.
explanation.definitionFit: To show something is to point it out or signal it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Feeling callous? Then destroy a settlement

indicators.note: settlement suggests the letters of then destroy a are settled into a new order

explanation.surface: Being callous, one goes on to destroy a village.
explanation.definitionFit: Stony-hearted means unfeeling and cruel, a synonym for callous.

clue.text: Flower goes to politician in ceremony

parts.note: a flower in crosswords is something that flows, a river: the Po in Italy
MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A bloom is presented to a politician at a formal occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Pomp is ceremonial splendour and display, so it stands for ceremony.

clue.text: Post office workers

definitions.meaning: a pole or stick, such as a walking stave
the employees of an organisation

explanation.surface: The people who work at a post office.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff is both a stick or post and the body of employees in an office.

clue.text: A pool I object about

parts.note: I as a grammatical object becomes me
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone protests about a swimming pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A mere is a lake or pond, a poetic or regional word for a pool.

clue.text: Where one may sit or get to one's feet

definitions.meaning: a grandstand where spectators take seats
rise up from sitting

explanation.surface: Sitting or rising, a choice of posture.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand is a spectator structure with seats, and to stand is to rise upright.

clue.text: Arranged tour around river and cathedral city

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the river abbreviation
arranged means the letters of tour are put in a new order

explanation.surface: An organised trip around a river and a city with a cathedral.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arranged' turns TOUR into TRUO, and 'around' puts R inside it. TRURO is the cathedral city of Cornwall in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Truro, in Cornwall, has a cathedral and city status, so it is an example of a cathedral city.

clue.text: An American can

parts.note: in American slang the can is a prison, so this is a jail in the United States

explanation.surface: A tin can made in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: Can is American slang for a jail, and a state prison is a large one.

clue.text: One shouldn't miss this store opening

definitions.meaning: proverbially the easiest target of all for a poor shot
the entrance to a farm storage building

explanation.surface: An unmissable shop opening event.
explanation.definitionFit: A barn door is proverbially too large to miss and is literally the door of a storage barn.

clue.text: The control of the stock-holder?

definitions.meaning: the advantage or upper hand in a situation
the hand gripping the stock, or handle, of a whip

explanation.surface: Who has power over a company's shareholders.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the whip hand means having control, and it is the hand holding the whip's stock.

clue.text: Bound to fight in brave company

definitions.meaning: set on combat, ready for a confrontation
accompanied by Native American warriors, called braves, heading to battle

explanation.surface: Someone determined to fight alongside courageous comrades.
explanation.definitionFit: On the warpath means angry and ready for conflict, originally of Native American braves going to war.

clue.text: V-sign shows one is not in agreement!

parts.note: Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A rude two-fingered gesture shows someone disagrees.
explanation.walkthrough: The V-sign is a rude British gesture; here it splits into the letter V and a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: To vary is to differ, so something that varies is not in agreement.

clue.text: Animal driven on the roads

definitions.meaning: a big cat of the Americas
a British make of car

explanation.surface: An animal being herded along the roads.
explanation.definitionFit: A jaguar is a big cat, and Jaguar is a British car marque.

clue.text: A long way off getting a return of service

indicators.note: return of means the service is read backwards

parts.note: the RAF, Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A tennis player far from the net gets back a serve.
explanation.definitionFit: Afar means at a great distance, an adverb synonym.

clue.text: Most important man in all Airdrie?

indicators.note: in means the letters run concealed within all Airdrie

explanation.surface: Asking who is the big man in the Scottish town of Airdrie.
explanation.walkthrough: Airdrie is a town in Scotland, which suits a Scottish landowner.
explanation.definitionFit: A laird is a Scottish landed proprietor, the leading man on an estate.

clue.text: Cut price bargain

definitions.meaning: a small cut with scissors
something cheap at the price, a good buy

explanation.surface: A reduced-price bargain in a sale.
explanation.definitionFit: A snip is a quick cut with scissors and also, in British usage, a real bargain.

clue.text: A study of foreign port

parts.note: a den is a private room for study

explanation.surface: A survey of an overseas harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Aden is a port city in Yemen, an example of a foreign port.

clue.text: Touched, dead astern

parts.note: aft means towards or at the stern of a ship

explanation.surface: A sailor touched by death at the back of the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Touched is slang for slightly mad, and daft means silly or crazy.

clue.text: Flood means Aunt Enid has to move

indicators.note: to move means the letters of Aunt Enid shift into a new order

explanation.surface: A relative has to relocate because of flood water.
explanation.definitionFit: To inundate is to flood or swamp, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Knock out some facts about aircraft

indicators.note: about means the facts go round the knockout

parts.note: data are a set of facts
KO is the boxing abbreviation for knockout

explanation.surface: A boxer flattens an opponent with a few facts about planes.
explanation.walkthrough: The DAKOTA is the Douglas DC-3 transport plane of the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dakota was a famous transport plane, so it is an example of an aircraft.

clue.text: A number in quiet surroundings provide music

indicators.note: surroundings means the calm word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: serene means calm, quiet
D is 500 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A song performed in peaceful surroundings to give music.
explanation.definitionFit: To serenade is to perform music for someone, a verb matching provide music.

clue.text: Took a hard look at various trades

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of trades are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone examined a range of different professions.
explanation.definitionFit: Stared means gazed fixedly, a hard look, in the past tense.
